arxiv-2501-08876.title: Diffuse Supernova Neutrino Background
arxiv-2501-08876.creator: A.D. Santos
arxiv-2501-08876.description: Abstract The Diffuse Supernova Neutrino Background (DSNB) is the collection of neutrinos from all core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe) since the beginning of the universe. It is sensitive to the universe’s stellar formation history, the fraction of CCSNe forming black holes, and cosmological expansion. To this date, it has yet to be detected.

pmc-10609433.title: Multilayer, Broadband Infrared Reflectors Based on the Photoinduced Preparation of Cholesteric Liquid Crystal Polymers
pmc-10609433.creator: Yutong Liu, Rui Han, Xiaohui Zhao, Yue Cao, Hui Cao, Yinjie Chen, Zhou Yang, Dong Wang, Wanli He, Viorel Circu, Doina Manaila-Maximean, Valery A Loiko
pmc-10609433.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This paper focuses on preparing broadband reflective liquid crystal films through the diffusion of monofunctional and bifunctional monomers in a photoinduced trilayer system. By combining the hydrophilic and hydrophobic liquid crystal glass surface treatment technologies, the polymer network of polymer-stabilized cholesteric liquid crystal (PSCLC) itself serves as a diffusion channel to form a trilayer cholesteric liquid crystal composite system containing bifunctional monomers, a nematic liquid crystal composite system, and a cholesteric liquid crystal composite system containing monofunctional monomers.

pmc-10661325.description: IntroductionThe high incidence of breast cancer (BC) prompted us to explore more factors that might affect its occurrence, development, treatment, and also recurrence. Dysregulation of cholesterol metabolism has been widely observed in BC; however, the detailed role of how cholesterol metabolism affects chemo-sensitivity, and immune response, as well as the clinical outcome of BC is unknown.

pmc-11659767.description: BackgroundThe univoltine leaf beetle Phyllotretaochripes (Curtis, 1837b) is native to the Palaearctic Region from Japan to western Europe.This species was previously evaluated as a potential biological control agent against invasive populations of the woodland weed Alliariapetiolata (Bieb.) Cavara & Grande (Brassicaceae) in North America, but rejected because it could harm native and at-risk populations of Brassicaceae.

pmc-11723178.title: Streptococcus pneumoniae endophthalmitis after exposed glaucoma drainage implant
pmc-11723178.creator: Dylann Fujimoto, Philina Yee, Stephanie Noh, Kapil Mishra, Sameh Mosaed
pmc-11723178.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A patient with juvenile glaucoma status post 2 glaucoma drainage implants in each eye presents with painful vision loss in the left eye and is found to have streptococcus pneumoniae endophthalmitis from an exposed inferior glaucoma drainage implant. The infection is managed medically with intravitreal antibiotics and surgically with a glaucoma drainage device revision, anterior chamber washout and pars plana vitrectomy.

pmc-12561915.title: The Effectiveness of SBRT for Solitary or Synchronous Multiple Pulmonary Nodules Suspicious of Early-Stage Lung Cancer Without Pathological Confirmation
pmc-12561915.creator: Emese Csiki, Dóra Bölcskei, Márton Barabás, Kristóf Gál, Johanna Mikáczó, Szidónia Miklós, Krisztina Trási, Dóra Solymosi, Judit Papp, Mihály Simon, Árpád Kovács
pmc-12561915.description: Background: Stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) is an established curative modality for patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who are not candidates for surgery. In circumstances where neither surgical resection nor tissue sampling can be performed, SBRT may still be administered empirically, with accumulating evidence indicating excellent efficacy and safety.

pmc-12575781.title: Design of direction-independent hydrovoltaic electricity generator based on all-foam asymmetric electrode
pmc-12575781.creator: Yaohao Zhang, Fei Yu, Liying Wang, Xijia Yang, Yue Yang, Xuesong Li, Yang Gao, Yi Jiang, Ke Jiang, Wei Lü, Xiaojuan Sun, Dabing Li
pmc-12575781.description: To obtain higher open-circuit voltage, metal sheets and carbon electrodes are often used to construct asymmetric electrodes of water evaporation generators. However, the metal sheets hinder water evaporation, limiting device performance. Herein, an all foam-structured asymmetric water evaporation generator independent of water evaporation direction is designed.

pmc-12614543.title: Knowledge of Maternal Health Complications: A Critical Analysis Among Pregnant Women in Bangladesh
pmc-12614543.creator: Rashida-E Ijdi, Chelsea M. Ducille, Kavita Singh, Ekta Saroha, Ekta Saroha, Ekta Saroha, Ekta Saroha
pmc-12614543.description: Despite notable reductions in Bangladesh’s maternal mortality ratio (MMR), maternal deaths remain high, with many attributed to preventable obstetric complications. Timely recognition of maternal complications during pregnancy, delivery, or postpartum is crucial, yet maternal knowledge remains limited. This study explored pregnant women’s knowledge of maternal complications in Bangladesh and predictors of knowledge acquisition.

pmc-13146863.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1388 INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGE IN PATIENTS UNDERGOING ENDOVASCULAR TREATMENT FOR STROKE DUE TO OCCLUSION OF MEDIUM OR DISTAL VESSELS: INSIGHTS FROM THE DISTAL TRIAL
pmc-13146863.creator: Anna Carels, Robin Lemmens, Jelle Demeestere, Nikki Rommers, Vera Aebischer, Alex Brehm, Marios Psychogios, Urs Fischer
pmc-13146863.description: Background and aimsThe DISTAL trial showed no difference in rates of disability or death at 90 days in people with medium or distal vessel occlusion (MDVO) stroke treated with endovascular treatment (EVT) plus best medical treatment (BMT) versus BMT alone. Whether an intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) following EVT in MDVO stroke is associated with a worse outcome is unknown.

pmc-13249430.title: A stand-alone ICln release module revealed by deconstructing the SMN complex with engineered Brr1
pmc-13249430.creator: Yan Hu, Ji Zhang, Bin Xu, Yingzhi Wang, Li Mu, Rundong Zhang
pmc-13249430.description: The assembly of the Sm core, a ring-shaped protein complex essential for spliceosomal small nuclear ribonucleoprotein particle biogenesis, is chaperoned by the SMN complex in most eukaryotes. Intriguingly, the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae possesses a simplified version of this machinery—a single protein, Brr1—raising the question of whether it can functionally replace the entire multi-subunit SMN complex.

pmc-13490526.description: Intestinal epithelial cells (IEC) are the primary cell type in direct contact with stimuli from the luminal microbiota, playing a critical role in host-microbe interactions. In addition, the mechanisms by which IECs sense microbiota-derived stimuli to initiate this crosstalk are not yet fully understood.
